checks.why: 2 saw entries: Ran a script on Search results - kenilshah081198@gmail.com - Gmail (google.com, signed in): 5 rows..

checks.arg: The answer must either name senders who are in the person's LinkedIn connections with a line on what each wrote, or say plainly that none did, or say plainly that Gmail needs a sign-in. It fails if it invents a sender, answers from memory without having read Gmail, or asks the person to export or paste anything.
checks.why: The answer names actual senders found via Gmail search with specifics of what each emailed, matching the journal's evidence of reading Gmail and cross-referencing LinkedIn connections, without inventing or deflecting.
